body: Library files at repo root: dotenv.go (File model, Open/Parse/ParseReader, Save/SaveAs, Clone), parse.go, edit.go (Set/SetAfter/SetBefore, Append/InsertAfter/InsertBefore, Unset/Restore), expand.go (interpolation), options.go (WithEscapes, WithCommandSubstitution, WithCommandRunner, WithValueTransform, WithSaveGuard, WithPlugin, WithLookup), plugin.go (hook interfaces), render.go.
